This ​achievement is a testament⁤ to ‍the rigorous training and dedication of⁢ the students, as well as the⁢ supportive surroundings provided​ by the UCAM .

Interview⁤ with Dr. Carlos Martínez, Medical⁣ Education expert at the UCAM Introduction toMedical Education at UCAM Interviewer (IV): What sets UCAM’s medical education program apart from others in⁤ Spain?
